stem: The system shows a batch as destroyed, but the physical waste container is still present. What is the best response?
choices: Preserve the discrepancy and material/status, report it, and follow the controlled reconciliation process
Dispose of the container immediately so reality matches the system
Relabel the waste as another batch
rationale: Destroying or relabeling the evidence would hide the discrepancy. The record/material conflict should remain visible until resolved.
